notes.title: No Players Online Demo Localisation Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958780/43e2eaa4f0ca1170baee45cad9094f622a72d5df.png[/img]

hello everyone!
we've been hard at work on no players online. part of the work has been put into localising the demo.

we've localised the demo for the following languages:
- simplified chinese
- traditional chinese
- brazilian portuguese
- polish
- korean
- japanese
- russian

all these languages will also be supported for the full release of no players online!

[i]more updates to follow...[/i]
<o>

notes.title: No Players Online joins Tiny Teams 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958780/f1633e8b0fe7d6e71abc6e5c4da8c22da2d2de61.png[/img]

thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared the game. we're hard at work on the full release!

in the meantime, we're participating in this year's tiny teams event, which highlights games made by tiny teams (like us!)
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]tiny teams 2024[/url][/b]

also, be sure to tune in for the official stream on [b][url=http://twitch.tv/yogscast]yogscast's twitch channel[/url][/b]. they're going to be checking out the demo on [b] thursday (aug 15th) at 11AM - 2PM (BST[/b]).

[i]more updates to follow...[/i]
<o>
